title: For each room, list its associated building name, floor number, room number
question: For each room, list its associated building name, floor number, room number, ownership type, organization name, number of rooms, area, and percentage of area relative to the building. Include subtotals across floors, subtotals across all floors for each building, and a grand total across all buildings. For the subtotal for each building and the grand total, the percentage of area should be relative to area of all buildings. All numeric values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators except the relative percentages which should be rounded to two decimal places.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    r.FLOOR,
    r.ROOM,
    r.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    r.AREA
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
building_totals AS (
  SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(AREA) AS building_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(AREA) AS all_area
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.FLOOR,
  b.ROOM,
  b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  b.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  FORMAT(COUNT(*), 0) AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA), 0) AS AREA,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA) * 100.0 / MAX(bt.building_area), 2) AS PCT_OF_BLDG
FROM base b
JOIN building_totals bt ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FLOOR, b.ROOM, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, b.ORGANIZATION_NAME
UNION ALL
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,

  'Subtotal' AS ROOM,
  b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  'All' AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  FORMAT(COUNT(*), 0) AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA), 0) AS AREA,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA) * 100.0 / MAX(bt.building_area), 2) AS PCT_OF_BLDG
FROM base b
JOIN building_totals bt ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FLOOR, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
UNION ALL
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  'All Floors' AS FLOOR,
  'Subtotal' AS ROOM,
  b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  'All' AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  FORMAT(COUNT(*), 0) AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA), 0) AS AREA,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA) * 100.0 / MAX(gt.all_area), 2) AS PCT_OF_BLDG
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
UNION ALL
SELECT

  'All' AS FLOOR,

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID AS org_id FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), LargeAssignableRooms AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, o.DLC_KEY FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms AS r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.DLC_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, i.window_column, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.FLOOR, i.ROOM, i.SPACE_ID, i.AREA, i.MAJOR_USE, i.DESCRIPTION, i.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE_FROM_HR, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL_FROM_HR FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON i.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NAME,
    b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
    r.FLOOR,
    r.ROOM,
    r.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    r.AREA
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
building_totals AS (
  SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, SUM(AREA) AS building_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(AREA) AS all_area
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.FLOOR,
  b.ROOM,
  b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  b.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  FORMAT(COUNT(*), 0) AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA), 0) AS AREA,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA) * 100.0 / MAX(bt.building_area), 2) AS PCT_OF_BLDG
FROM base b
JOIN building_totals bt ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FLOOR, b.ROOM, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE, b.ORGANIZATION_NAME
UNION ALL
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.FLOOR,
  'Subtotal' AS ROOM,
  b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  'All' AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  FORMAT(COUNT(*), 0) AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA), 0) AS AREA,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA) * 100.0 / MAX(bt.building_area), 2) AS PCT_OF_BLDG
FROM base b
JOIN building_totals bt ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.FLOOR, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
UNION ALL
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  'All Floors' AS FLOOR,
  'Subtotal' AS ROOM,
  b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE,
  'All' AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  FORMAT(COUNT(*), 0) AS NUM_ROOMS,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA), 0) AS AREA,
  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA) * 100.0 / MAX(gt.all_area), 2) AS PCT_OF_BLDG
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
GROUP BY b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.OWNERSHIP_TYPE
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'GRAND TOTAL' AS BUILDING_NAME,

  FORMAT(SUM(b.AREA), 0) AS AREA,

FROM base b
CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

  JOIN BuildingTotals bt ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bt.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

  COALESCE(ORGANIZATION, 'ALL') AS OrganizationName,
